scope: baseline same-visit locked samples; existing W13-W15 artifacts preserved

microbiome.input: W13 full species relative-abundance fractions; existing sparse-null encoding only
microbiome.fit_rows: unique participants in the relevant training fold; never repeated Daily rows
microbiome.positive_values: unchanged; do not censor low positive abundances
transform: close retained species to row sum 1
microbiome.constant_output: drop CLR columns with training SD <= 1e-12; keep CLR reference feature set unchanged
microbiome.unusable_support: explicit failure; no invented score; caller must use prespecified no-score handling
microbiome.sample_selection: inherit W13 lock; no resampling, nearest-date selection, or source-column overwrite
microbiome.validation: apply saved training taxa, pseudocounts, CLR reference, means and SDs; never refit
microbiome.primary_alternative: no automatic log10(PPM) or prevalence-threshold search

phenotype.input: each endpoint after existing unit/basic QC and prescribed measurement aggregation
phenotype.fit_rows: unique training participants for each person-level endpoint
phenotype.robust_interval: shortest sorted contiguous interval containing ceil(0.95*n_finite) training values; leftmost interval on ties
phenotype.remove: abs(x-mu) > 8*SD; set only this endpoint value to missing
phenotype.winsorize: remaining finite values clipped to [mu-5*SD, mu+5*SD]
phenotype.degenerate_scale: halt automated transformation for endpoint if n<3 or robust SD<=0/nonfinite
phenotype.units: retain original endpoint units; no automatic log or z-score
phenotype.validation: apply frozen training thresholds, do not recompute on validation/confirmation
phenotype.retention: keep original values and per-value flags; no global complete-case deletion
phenotype.sensitivity: same locked model specification using basic-QC original endpoints; report separately, do not choose primary by significance
phenotype.instrument_QC: only claim checks supported by accessible source fields
phenotype.Daily_CGM: retain existing point/day QC; do not transfer person-level bounds to daily means or fit person-level rules to repeated days

execution.real_Y_reads: none in this amendment; future reads through existing guarded workflow with receipts
execution.real_fit: after W18 role freeze, within each training fold; no final thresholds, taxon counts, cohort N or fitted scores yet
execution.food: prior proposed event/day QC retained as separate pending amendment; not applied by this package
